item.title: Trump revokes US scientific finding behind climate change regulations
item.description: Trump administration rescinds 'endangerment finding' that serves as the legal bases to curb greenhouse gas emissions.

item.title: US judge blocks Trump administration from punishing Senator Mark Kelly
item.description: Judge Richard J Leon, a Republican appointee, has rejected the government's case as 'anemic' and 'horsefeathers'.

item.title: Trump is the ‘elephant in the room’ as the African Union holds new summit
item.description: Trump's policies on tariffs, foreign aid and immigration have outsized impact as African Union leaders seek 'balance'.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,450
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,450 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: US and Taiwan sign ‘pivotal’ deal to cut tariffs
item.description: Taipei agrees to buy some $85bn of US energy, aircraft and equipment in exchange for 15 percent tariff rate.

item.title: South Africa’s Ramaphosa says troops will deploy to tackle crime gangs
item.description: President Cyril Ramaphosa says the military will work with the country's police force to counter 'gang wars'.

item.title: Japan seizure of Chinese vessel, arrest of captain, could heighten tensions
item.description: Japan's Fisheries Agency says Chinese captain arrested for allegedly defying orders to stop for inspection at sea.

item.title: New CIA recruitment video targets Chinese military personnel
item.description: The CIA's latest YouTube video offers instructions for how to contact the agency on the encrypted Tor Browser.

item.title: Israel deprives Palestinians of proper education by withholding revenues
item.description: Palestinian education is being destroyed by Israel's policy of withholding Palestinian Authority customs revenues.

item.title: Top Goldman Sachs lawyer Kathy Ruemmler resigns over Epstein ties
item.description: Ruemmler's resignation comes after emails revealed her links to the late sex offender.
